text:
Sam: Hey @Priya — welcome to your first week shadow! :wave: I'm on shift as primary tonight 18:00-02:00PT, Ajay is secondary. This thread is just for quick handoff notes and any coverage gotchas.

Priya: Thanks Sam! Quick Q — where do you usually put the runbook links and the short checklist?

Sam: Right in the handoff message and pinned to the channel. Also we keep a one-line handoff in the rotation calendar. main runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff (you'll need VPN/KMS access).

Priya: Got it, VPN is set up. Anything I should read before shadowing an incident?

Ajay: Two quick things: 1) if incident-bot pages with P1, acknowledge within 2 min and drop into #incident-bridge unless it's obviously a pager storm. 2) Use the mini-play in the runbook for noisy queues — short-circuit batching, increase replicas, restart worker pool.

Sam: Also FYI — we have an abbreviated handoff template I use. Copy/paste when you take primary: 
```
Handoff by: <name>
Shift: <start>-<end> PT
Primary: <name>
Secondary: <name>
Open incidents: <list or none>
Known issues/fragile services: <one-liners>
Escalation path: pager -> secondary -> lead oncall -> eng-sre -> SRE manager
Channel links: #incident-bridge, runbook URL
```

Priya: Nice. Can you show a sample incident flow?

Sam: Sure. Last week incident example: incident-bot posted a P1 for inference-timeouts at 01:12. Steps: 1) acknowledge, 2) create bridge, 3) check dashboards (latency QPS), 4) pin temporary routing to fallback model, 5) escalate to infra if GPU hosts flapping. I left the snippet in the runbook under 'inference-timeouts'.

incident-bot: [ALERT] P1 — inference-timeouts detected in prod (svc: runtime-gateway). Pager sent to eng-oncall-primary, eng-oncall-secondary at 2026-03-14T01:12:03Z :pager: See incident: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-0314-17

Kristen: tagging for context — this usually correlates with a downstream cache eviction that increases cold-start latency. If you see a spike in KV-misses, try the 'cache-rapid-fill' step in the runbook first.

Priya: Following along, thanks. If I shadow an incoming page, do I ever interact with customers?

Sam: Usually no — we have SRE/PM handle customer comms for P1s unless it's a specific customer-impacted issue that you need to own. Document the impact in the incident doc and handoff.

Ajay: One more practical tip: the rotation calendar sometimes has gaps during holiday swaps. If you notice a coverage gap for the next day, flag it early and we can do a swap or split the shift.

Priya: I see a swap request on the calendar for Saturday 02:00-10:00PT that doesn't have a secondary assigned. Should I claim it or is that handled by ops?

Sam: Claim it if you want more hands-on time, but check with Ajay first for overlap with his on-call week. If you don't, ops will auto-assign a backup (last-resort).

Priya: I'll check calendar and ping Ajay.

Ajay: Yup I can overlap Sat morning 02:00-05:00PT to help show the ropes. Also, here's a short checklist I read when shadowing: 
- Confirm pager routing works (send test via incident-bot to test-targets)
- Open terminal to prod logs and tail the runtime gateway logs
- Pull up token-cost dashboard to see obvious spikes
- Confirm access to KMS and runbook links

Sam: Great. One more thing — when ending your shadow shift, please post a brief handoff with: what you observed, any open alerts, and whether you feel comfortable taking the next primary. That makes scheduling for leads easier.

Priya: Sounds good. I'll do that after my first shadow tonight. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

Sam: Awesome — I'll DM you a short list of common search queries for logs. If incident-bot pages, take notes in the incident doc and I'll walk you through the postmortem steps tomorrow morning.

incident-bot: [INFO] Scheduled shadowing checklist test at 2026-03-14T18:05:00Z — runbook check OK.

Kristen: Welcome again @Priya. If you want to practice, we can trigger a low-risk simulated page later and walk through the steps in real time.

Priya: Would love that. Schedule it whenever convenient for you folks.

Sam: Cool — I'll schedule a 15min sim at 19:30PT. End-to-end shadow tonight.

Priya: Thanks everyone!
